'''Mahogany Town''' is a small town, that is accessed from the North via [[Route 43]], the West via [[Route 42]], and the East via [[Route 44]].

This city contains Mahogany Town's Gym, with Pryce as its leader.

Although there is no Poké Mart, the Elderly Woman in the house North of the Gym sells [[List of Clothes|clothes]].

== Gym Puzzle ==
[[File:Mahogany_Gym_Solution.mp4|right|thumb]]
To reach Pryce, the player must slide along the ice and push the Pokéball into the goal on the right. Some of the gym trainers must be used to block the Pokéball's path so that it can be pushed to the correct position, however the trainers will move so good timing is required.
